invariants.rationale: After the setAlignment method runs, label's lineAlign is always set to one of Align.left, Align.right, or Align.center.
labelAlign is assigned directly to this.labelAlign at method entry.
this.lineAlign is set by matching lineAlign with Align.left, then Align.right, otherwise Align.center.
After execution, this.lineAlign is guaranteed to be set to Align.left, Align.right, or Align.center.
